channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Denúncias de propaganda política irregular já somam mais de 50 mil no TSE
item.description: The Electoral Justice has received 51,395 complaints of irregular advertising through the Pardal application since the start of the campaign for the 2026 general elections. The system, created by the Supreme Federal Court, enables monitoring of political content on social media.

item.title: Meu vice, Alfredo Gaspar, é católico fervoroso. Meu pai também é católico, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro highlighted the Catholic faith of his running mate, Alfredo Gaspar, and his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as an ideological alignment point in the PL presidential campaign. The reference was made during an interview where he emphasized traditional values tied to Catholic faith. Religious themes carry weight among the evangelical and Catholic base of the candidate.

item.title: Flávio: Caneta de emagrecimento no SUS é a nova picanha do Lula, ele não vai entregar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized President Lula's proposal to distribute weight-loss pens through the SUS, calling it the 'new picanha' and claiming Lula will not deliver on the promise. The statement was made during his electoral campaign, reinforcing the PL's stance on controversial public health policies.

item.title: Flávio: Não existe projeto de lei sobre retirada do título de N. Sra de Padroeira do Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, denied again having a bill to remove the title of Our Lady of Aparecida as Patroness of Brazil, accusing others of spreading the claim. He reiterated his stance to protect the religious symbol during the election campaign.

item.title: Flávio: Olham para mim enxergando legado de Jair Bolsonaro com outra postura
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, states he aims to represent Jair Bolsonaro's political legacy but with a distinct posture. He emphasized continuing the ideological line of his father, former president, while advocating an updated approach.

item.title: PSD declara apoio a Celina Leão após Arruda ter candidatura rejeitada pelo TSE
item.description: The PSD declared support for Celina Leão (PP) and her running mate Gustavo Rocha (Republicanos) for the Federal District government after José Arruda had his candidacy rejected by the TSE. The decision was announced in a meeting between party representatives and the current governor. The PSD's support strengthens the alliance between the parties in the district election.

item.title: Janja volta a surfar em fake news sobre padroeira do Brasil
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula delivered a polarizing speech at a campaign rally in Belém, countering false claims that Flávio Bolsonaro sought to strip Nossa Senhora Aparecida of her status as Brazil’s patron saint, while accusing him of ties to a militia-linked 'clique.' She emphasized President Lula’s record and stressed outreach to undecided voters to secure a first-round win.

item.title: O que mostra a movimentação de Lula e Flávio nas últimas duas pesquisas presidenciais
item.description: Polling data shows favorable movement for Lula in the first round, keeping the race tight against Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential second round. Indecisive voters may become increasingly important in a highly competitive election with small swings.

item.title: Governo cria comitê contra bets ilegais; saiba como funcionará
item.description: The federal government created the Interinstitucional Committee for Monitoring the Exploitation and Illegal Advertising of Fixed-Odds Bets, composed of 15 federal agency representatives, to combat illegal gambling activities following the enactment of Provisional Measure 1.394/2026. The committee will share intelligence, establish an integrated database of irregular domains, set blocking protocols, and submit biannual reports to the Casa Civil. Meetings will occur every six months with potential extraordinary sessions.

item.title: Governo Lula adia reunião com times de futebol para discutir MP das Bets
item.description: The federal government postponed the meeting with football clubs and the CBF regarding the impact of the sports betting ban, citing only logistical reasons. The new date will be set and announced later. Ministers such as Dario Durigan emphasized the intention to listen to the sector's demands before making decisions.

item.title: TSE recebeu mais de 50 mil denúncias de propaganda irregular
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) has received 51,395 complaints about irregular campaign advertising through the Pardal app since the start of the 2026 election cycle. The most common type (43.78%) involves irregular advertisements on public roads, followed by ads on private property and public assets. São Paulo leads with 10,388 complaints, and 27% of cases have been converted into formal proceedings.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos cinco maiores colégios eleitorais do país
item.description: Recent Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in the first round in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, while Lula leads in Minas Gerais. Technical ties are indicated in São Paulo and Minas Gerais due to margin of error, suggesting close competition. In the second round, Flávio maintains an advantage in São Paulo, with a technical tie observed in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Fachin avalia proposta para pautar caso da Nossa Senhora na 4ª feira
item.description: STF President Luiz Edson Fachin is considering whether to bring to the plenary his decision overturning a preliminary injunction by André Mendonça that allowed publication about Our Lady of Aparecida. The case has drawn criticism from TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques, who questions Supreme Court interference in electoral justice.

item.title: TRE-SP proíbe propaganda de Tarcísio com participação de Nunes
item.description: TRE-SP banned a 30-second campaign ad featuring Tarcísio de Freitas and São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes, ruling Nunes acted as a supporter, exceeding the legal 25% participation limit. The decision was upheld by majority, with Tarcísio’s defense announcing an appeal. The ad highlighted partnerships between the city and state governments.

item.title: Lula diz que 'ninguém vai avacalhar com Nossa Senhora Aparecida' enquanto ele for presidente
item.description: Lula vowed to protect Nossa Senhora Aparecida and criticized the Lagoinha church over ties to Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro denied involvement in removing the Patron Saint title, calling the controversy fake news and blaming the PT.

item.title: Janja chama Flávio de “Bozo filho” e associa clã Bolsonaro a milícia
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva referred to Flávio Bolsonaro as 'Bozo son' and linked his family to the 'familia' group during a rally in Belém. She also referenced investigations into alleged ties between Flávio and militias, along with the Banco Master case, reinforcing criticism of the previous administration.

item.title: Vorcaro pede para votar nas eleições e título é transferido para a Papuda
item.description: Former banker Daniel Vorcaro, currently held in preventive detention at the Papuda prison complex, has had his voter registration transferred to the facility and remains eligible to vote in the 2026 elections because his conviction has not yet become final. He is under investigation in the Compliance Zero operation for alleged billion-dollar frauds in the Brazilian financial system.

item.title: Flávio: PT aposta na divisão, agora tiveram audácia de colocar católicos contra evangélicos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accused the PT of promoting polarization and attempting to divide Catholics and Evangelicals, denying rumors about removing Our Lady of Aparecida's title as Brazil's patron saint. In an interview with the SantoFlow Podcast, he emphasized the need to avoid a more divided country and reaffirmed continuity with his father Jair Bolsonaro's legacy, but with a different stance.

item.title: Lula diz que Nossa Senhora 'não será avacalhada' e ataca templo de Vorcaro: 'Igreja mentirosa é aquela da Lagoinha'
item.description: Lula used a rally in Belém to defend Our Lady of Aparecida and criticize pastor André Valadão and Daniel Vorcaro. He indirectly attacked Jair Bolsonaro and reaffirmed his stance on sovereignty and Trump.

item.title: AO VIVO: LULA EM BELÉM DO PARÁ (ELEIÇÕES 2026- NOTÍCIAS POLÍTICA)
item.description: Lula visits Belém do Pará during the 2026 election campaign. The event is broadcast live but the video shows technical failures and audio limitations. The coverage reinforces the PT leader's role in the national scenario.

item.title: O bastidor da queda de braço entre TSE e STF no caso da Nossa Senhora
item.description: Tensions are rising between the TSE and STF over jurisdiction and oversight of electoral decisions, particularly following the appointment of Nunes Marques and André Mendonça by Jair Bolsonaro. The conflict intensified with the Flávio Bolsonaro controversy over references to Nossa Senhora Aparecida, brought before the STF plenary by Flávio Dino.

item.title: Fim das bets: sindicato dos clubes de futebol e das federações pede ao STF suspensão da MP ou período de transição de seis meses
item.description: The National Union of Professional Football Associations (Sinafut) requested the STF to suspend the MP banning betting sites or, alternatively, a six-month transition period, citing impacts on the 2027 budgets and national competitions. The entity, representing clubs, federations and the CBF, joins betting houses in challenging the provisional measure.

item.title: Ancelotti usa Raphinha em nova posição e quer repetir sucesso do Barcelona
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti chooses to use Raphinha as a striker for the Brazilian national team, leveraging the strong start to his season at Barcelona. The player, who has already scored 14 goals and provided 4 assists in nine matches, will be promoted to lead the attack in a 4-3-3 formation. Ancelotti highlighted Raphinha's positive adaptation to the new role.

item.title: Pastores acusam Lula de promover guerra religiosa
item.description: Evangelical pastors from Cimeb accuse President Lula of promoting a religious war by sharing a false news story about Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly intending to remove the title of Patroness from Our Lady of Aparecida. The accusation was made through an official statement released on April 28th. The case is seen as an escalation of tensions between the evangelical church and the federal government.

item.title: A desconfiança histórica despertada por polêmica sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: A false controversy about Flávio Bolsonaro allegedly removing Our Lady of Aparecida from sainthood sparked distrust among evangelicals and Catholics, damaging his campaign in the final stretch of the elections. The rumor spread rapidly on social media and was amplified by past statements from the candidate about religion, forcing him to adopt a more conciliatory tone.

item.title: Ex-secretário e assessor xinga eleitor de ‘animal’ e ‘imbecil’ por não votar em Zema; veja vídeo
item.description: Bernardo Santos, former Minister of Communication of Minas Gerais and ex-chairman of Novo, insulted a voter who didn't vote for Zema, calling them an imbecile and animal. He posted the video on Instagram, stating he disagreed with how voters were casting their ballots. Santos denied that his insults impacted Zema and said he doesn't intend to remove the content.

item.title: Times de futebol decidem boicotar reunião com Lula sobre bets
item.description: Major Brazilian football clubs decide to boycott federal meeting over betting house ban, impacting millions in revenue. The provisional measure prohibits advertising and sponsorships from betting companies, with platform blocking starting October 6th. Lula criticizes clubs' stance and states that 'those who can' should seek alternatives.

item.title: Pesquisas mostram a distância entre Lula e Flávio nos três estados da região Sul
item.description: Quaest polls show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in voter intentions across the three Southern states, with notable margins in both rounds, particularly in Santa Catarina and Paraná. The widest gap appears in the Santa Catarina runoff, where Flávio leads by 36 percentage points.

item.title: Confira como foi a segunda-feira (28) dos candidatos a presidente
item.description: In the final week of campaigning, candidates intensified their schedules with rallies and media appearances. Lula emphasized public healthcare policies, while Samara Martins gathered support for abortion legalization. Other candidates walked neighborhoods, addressed economic issues, and committed to fiscal discipline.

item.title: Bastidores: com Flamengo e Palmeiras do mesmo lado, clubes esvaziaram reunião com o governo sobre fim das bets
item.description: Major Brazilian football clubs, including Flamengo and Palmeires, boycotted a government meeting regarding the ban on sports betting, viewing the gathering as politically motivated and challenging the legality of the provisional decree. State federations and executives opposed the measure, criticizing the government's approach. The CBF remains neutral but suffers financial losses in prize payments due to the loss of betting sponsors.

item.title: Conselho de pastores acusa Lula de 'promover guerra religiosa' com 'fake news': 'Evangélicos e católicos vivem em paz'
item.description: The Brazilian Evangelical Ministers Council (Cimeb) accused President Lula of spreading 'fake news' by implying that Flávio Bolsonaro sought to remove the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida, asserting that evangelicals and Catholics live in peace. The controversy sparked online reactions, with the CNBB denying any involvement in spreading false information.

item.title: 'Posso considerar uma espécie de facada essa fake news em mim', diz Flávio Bolsonaro em podcast católico
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from the PL party, likened a fake news story involving Our Lady of Aparecida to a 'knife attack' endured by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in 2018. He blamed the PT for spreading the false information and emphasized the importance of faith in facing the accusations.

item.title: Salles desistiu do Senado: o que acontece com os votos e a foto dele na urna?
item.description: Federal deputy Ricardo Salles (Novo-SP) withdrew from the São Paulo Senate race six days before the October 4 election. His name and photo will remain on the ballot, but votes will not be transferred and will be counted as null. The withdrawal comes amid low polling numbers and pressure to support André do Prado's candidacy.

item.title: Caiado nega acordo com Zema para apoiar Flávio
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) denied any deal with Romeu Zema (Novo) to support Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Both confirmed they will not withdraw their presidential bids.

item.title: Renan Santos afirma que vai 'resolver problema do STF' e defende volta da prisão em 2ª instância
item.description: Renan Santos claimed he intends to resolve the 'STF problem' and support reinstating second-instance imprisonment, criticizing the Court as corrupt. During his campaign stop in ES, he proposed security measures against organized crime and investments in infrastructure, tourism, and exports.

item.title: Lula liga ao vivo para Flávio Dino, do STF, antes de sancionar lei no PA
item.description: President Lula makes a live video call to Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino during a federal event in Pará before signing a bill. The call was broadcast live, but Dino was not heard during the session.

item.title: Renan promete acionar Justiça se Globo não chamá-lo para debate sem Lula
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) threatens legal action against TV Globo if not invited to the presidential debate in case Lula does not participate. The broadcaster agreed that, in the event of an absent candidate, the replacement would be the one leading the polls. Renan leads over Romeu Zema and may join the debate.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao TSE cassação da chapa de Lula por abuso de poder
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the annulment of Lula's ticket for political and economic abuse of power, accusing the Ministry of Culture of using public resources to benefit the campaign. The lawsuit also seeks the disqualification of First Lady Janja, Minister Margareth Menezes, and other ministry officials. According to the candidate, there was misuse of public machinery during events and dissemination of electoral materials.

item.title: Nunes Marques alerta Fachin sobre risco de “captura institucional” do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, warned Minister Edson Fachin about the risk of 'institutional capture' of the court, requesting the STF to filter election-related petitions. The concern arises amid debates on transparency and TSE's independence.

item.title: Janja usa medalha de Nossa Senhora Aparecida após fake news sobre padroeira
item.description: First Lady Janja wore a medal of Nossa Senhora Aparecida during an event where President Lula signed a bill supporting women's football, amidfalse news claiming that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro would try to remove the title of patron saint from the Virgin. The misinformation, spread by left-wing profiles on social networks, reached nearly 1 million shares and was subject toa removal order from the TSE, later revoked by the STF. Despite confirming the news was false, Lula referenced the rumor in an interview with TV Band.

item.title: A medida sugerida por Nunes Marques a Fachin contra ‘esvaziamento’ do TSE
item.description: The president of the TSE, Nunes Marques, requested the president of the STF, Edson Fachin, to implement a filter for urgent petitions related to the elections, aiming to prevent jurisdictional overlap and safeguard equality among candidates.

item.title: Flávio pede cassação da chapa de Lula por abuso de poder
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro requested the TSE to annul Lula and Alckmin's ticket for alleged abuse of power, claiming the Ministry of Culture was used to support the campaign. The lawsuit also seeks ineligibility for Janja, Margareth Menezes and other ministry officials.

item.title: Projeto de lei apresentado pelo governo torna crime a exploração e a publicidade de bets
item.description: The federal government submitted a bill (PL 5477/26) making it a crime to exploit and advertise bets, fixed-odds betting lotteries, with sentences of 2 to 6 years in prison and fines. The measure complements MP 1194/26, which provisionally banned bets, and includes crimes such as operating, promoting, or financially facilitating bets, with increased penalties for online games, health data misuse, or age verification bypassing. The proposal does not apply to Loteca, keeping it allowed.

item.title: Lula pede presença de ex-ministro Celso Sabino no palco de ato no Pará
item.description: President Lula decided that former minister Celso Sabino will go on stage during the campaign rally in Belém, even though he is not part of the PT-backed slate in Pará. Sabino is running for Senate independently, and Lula personally endorsed his candidacy. His inclusion on stage follows pressure from the PT to have the ally participate in the event.

item.title: O que o brasileiro pensa sobre o fim das bets, segundo enquete do Senado Federal
item.description: The Brazilian Senate opened a public consultation regarding the federal government's ban on sports betting lots (bets), with over 283,000 people in favor and 74,000 against at the time of reporting. The measure aims to reduce social and economic harms linked to gambling, including family debt and mental health risks, particularly among youth. The poll remains active while the issue is under consideration by Congress.

item.title: O reforço de Soninha a Tebet após a desistência de Salles em São Paulo
item.description: Following Ricardo Salles' withdrawal, Soninha Francine endorsed Simone Tebet for the Senate, strengthening a centrist programmatic alliance. Tebet emphasized the alignment of proposals with the Cidadania candidate, supported since 2022.

item.title: Justiça concede liberdade a Wilker Leão sem fiança ou medidas cautelares
item.description: Federal Justice granted provisional release to federal deputy candidate Wilker Leão (Novo), arrested in flagrante for damaging University of Brasília property. The judge decided not to require bail or precautionary measures, finding no grounds for preventive detention. The case involved painting activity and threats during the incident at UnB.

item.title: Em meio à disputa acirrada para Senado, Soninha apoia Tebet, rival de chapa
item.description: Soninha Francine (Cidadania) endorsed Simone Tebet (PSB) in the São Paulo Senate race, recommending a second vote for senator. Despite being part of the PSDB-Cidadania federation supporting Tarcísio, Soninha emphasized convergences with Tebet and advocated for both seats to be held by women.

item.title: O destino do País vai às urnas
item.description: The article discusses the importance of the 2026 elections to determine the country's future, highlighting Roberto Amaral's role as a political analyst. It addresses central issues such as economy, security, and corruption, reflecting on Brazil's democratic challenges. The author emphasizes the need for a qualitative debate in the polls.

item.title: Dino avisa que ferramentas xandônicas são exclusivas, após Mendonça usar porteira aberta por Moraes
item.description: André Mendonça censored social media posts relying on TSE jurisprudence, but Flávio Dino challenged the use of Moraes-era tools, signaling that a parallel election court is already active to curb broad censorship powers. The episode highlights tension within the Supreme Court over balancing disinformation control and free speech.
